lesson.intro: This, that, these and those are pointing words. They tell us [[how many]] things there are and [[how near]] they are.
points: [[This]] = one thing that is near: This is my pencil.
[[That]] = one thing that is far: That is a bird.
[[These]] = many things that are near: These are my shoes.
[[Those]] = many things that are far: Those are mountains.
Use "is" with this and that. Use "are" with these and those.
lesson.tip: One → this/that. Many → these/those. Near → this/these. Far → that/those.
